entries.title: Proverbs 31:1
segments: The words of king Lemuel; the oracle which his mother taught him.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:2
segments: What, my son? and what, O son of my womb? And what, O son of my vows?

entries.title: Proverbs 31:3
segments: Give not thy strength unto women, Nor thy ways to that which destroyeth kings.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:4
segments: It is not for kings, O Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine; Nor for princes [to say], Where is strong drink?

entries.title: Proverbs 31:5
segments: Lest they drink, and forget the law, And pervert the justice [due] to any that is afflicted.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:6
segments: Give strong drink unto him that is ready to perish, And wine unto the bitter in soul:

entries.title: Proverbs 31:7
segments: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, And remember his misery no more.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:8
segments: Open thy mouth for the dumb, In the cause of all such as are left desolate.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:9
segments: Open thy mouth, judge righteously, And minister justice to the poor and needy.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:10
segments: A worthy woman who can find? For her price is far above rubies.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:11
segments: The heart of her husband trusteth in her, And he shall have no lack of gain.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:12
segments: She doeth him good and not evil All the days of her life.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:13
segments: She seeketh wool and flax, And worketh willingly with her hands.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:14
segments: She is like the merchant-ships; She bringeth her bread from afar.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:15
segments: She riseth also while it is yet night, And giveth food to her household, And their task to her maidens.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:16
segments: She considereth a field, and buyeth it; With the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:17
segments: She girdeth her loins with strength, And maketh strong her arms.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:18
segments: She perceiveth that her merchandise is profitable: Her lamp goeth not out by night.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:19
segments: She layeth her hands to the distaff, And her hands hold the spindle.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:20
segments: She stretcheth out her hand to the poor; Yea, she reacheth forth her hands to the needy.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:21
segments: She is not afraid of the snow for her household; For all her household are clothed with scarlet.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:22
segments: She maketh for herself carpets of tapestry; Her clothing is fine linen and purple.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:23
segments: Her husband is known in the gates, When he sitteth among the elders of the land.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:24
segments: She maketh linen garments and selleth them, And delivereth girdles unto the merchant.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:25
segments: Strength and dignity are her clothing; And she laugheth at the time to come.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:26
segments: She openeth her mouth with wisdom; And the law of kindness is on her tongue.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:27
segments: She looketh well to the ways of her household, And eateth not the bread of idleness.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:28
segments: Her children rise up, and call her blessed; Her husband [also], and he praiseth her, [saying]:

entries.title: Proverbs 31:29
segments: Many daughters have done worthily, But thou excellest them all.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:30
segments: Grace is deceitful, and beauty is vain; [But] a woman that feareth Jehovah, she shall be praised.

entries.title: Proverbs 31:31
segments: Give her of the fruit of her hands; And let her works praise her in the gates.
